components.css: .ds-shelf{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;padding:0 14px 16px;height:204px;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent 0 188px,var(--board-top,oklch(0.66 0.13 255)) 188px 191px,var(--board-face,oklch(0.47 0.15 262)) 191px 204px)}.ds-box{position:relative;height:188px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;text-decoration:none}.ds-inner{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:2px;height:94%;transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)}.ds-box:hover .ds-inner,.ds-box:focus-visible .ds-inner{transform:translateY(-8px)}.ds-box:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--paper,oklch(0.975 0.01 260));outline-offset:3px}.ds-spine{width:30px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:3px 3px 1px 1px;background:hsl(200 55% 40%);color:oklch(0.99 0.005 260)}.ds-spine b{width:100%;padding:7px 0 6px;text-align:center;font:800 1rem/1 'Sofia Sans XC','Sofia Sans',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;background:oklch(0 0 0 / .22)}.ds-spine i{flex:1;writing-mode:vertical-rl;transform:rotate(180deg);padding:9px 0;font:normal 700 .84rem/1 'Sofia Sans XC','Sofia Sans',sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em}.ds-spine em{font:normal 800 .75rem/1 'Sofia Sans XC','Sofia Sans',sans-serif;margin-bottom:6px;padding:3px 3px 2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--watched,oklch(0.87 0.165 96));color:var(--watched-ink,oklch(0.27 0.06 75))}.ds-spine.ds-empty{background:none;color:var(--ink-3,oklch(0.77 0.065 262));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px oklch(1 0 0 / .32)}.ds-spine.ds-empty b{background:none}.ds-sticker{position:absolute;top:0;right:-8px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--paper,oklch(0.975 0.01 260));color:var(--paper-ink,oklch(0.28 0.13 266));font:800 .875rem/1 'Sofia Sans XC','Sofia Sans',sans-serif;transform:rotate(-8deg)}

narrative.overview:
Boxset draws a lifetime of watched TV as a shelf of box sets, flat and graphic, on a Blu-ray cobalt ground. Every season is a spine coloured from its show's poster; a watched season is a filled spine with the show's name printed vertically, an unwatched one is an empty clear case: an outline with nothing printed on it. The gaps are the data. Numbers (hours, seasons, episodes) are set in an extra-condensed face and read like the spec block on the back of a case.

The surface is drenched, not decorated. Cobalt is the page, not an accent on white or black; depth comes from three tonal steps of the same blue (sunk, ground, raised) and from flat two-tone shelf boards, never from bevels, grain, sheen or ambient shadow. Colour carries meaning with discipline: yellow means watched and nothing else, white is the sticker colour for ratings, tiers and the primary action, and each show's own spine colour is the only chromatic variety on the page.

Density is moderate and phone-first: one-handed controls of 44px and up, divider-tab navigation that sits on top on desktop and hangs from the bottom edge on phone. The rejected direction is the streaming-clone poster grid on black with a red accent.
keyCharacteristics: Blu-ray cobalt drench in three tonal steps; flat boards with a light top line and a cobalt face.
Spines coloured from each poster, clamped so white lettering stays legible.
Empty and partly watched seasons as outlined empty cases with no title.
Yellow reserved for "watched"; white reserved for stickers, ratings, tiers and the primary action.
Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, uppercase, for spines, figures, headings and labels; Sofia Sans for reading.
One authored motion: the box set slides off the shelf into its detail page.

rules.name: The Yellow Means Watched Rule
rules.body: Watched Yellow appears only where it states that something was watched (or how often). Never use it for emphasis, links, ratings or decoration.

rules.name: The Sticker Rule
rules.body: Sticker White marks judgement and the primary action: ratings, tiers, the primary button, toasts and focus. Inactive and navigational chrome stays in ink on cobalt.

rules.name: The Spine Owns Its Colour Rule
rules.body: Per-show colour lives only on objects that belong to that show (spine, stack bar, case, blank cover). Chrome never borrows a show's colour.

rules.name: The Condensed Speaks, Sans Reads Rule
rules.body: Anything that names, counts or labels (headings, figures, tabs, buttons, spines) is Sofia Sans Extra Condensed, uppercase. Anything read as a sentence is Sofia Sans, sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change or be compared (counts, hours, episode numbers, ratings, progress) uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Label Belongs To A Value Rule
rules.body: Small tracked uppercase labels exist only to name the figure or control directly beneath them. They never sit above a heading as a decorative tag.

rules.name: The Seam Rule
rules.body: Group related tiles with a 3px gap of ground inside a shared rounded container, not with borders or separate floating cards.

rules.name: The No Fake Material Rule
rules.body: No bevels, gradients-as-lighting, grain, gloss or ambient card shadows. If it needs to look recessed, use Sunk Cobalt; if lifted, Raised Cobalt.

dos: Do keep the page drenched in Blu-ray Cobalt and express depth with Sunk and Raised Cobalt only.
Do show unwatched seasons as outlined empty cases (1.5px inset Case Line, no fill, no title).
Do use Watched Yellow only to say "watched" or "how often watched".
Do use Sticker White for ratings, tiers, the primary action, toasts and focus rings.
Do set names, numbers, tabs and buttons in Sofia Sans Extra Condensed uppercase with tabular figures; set sentences in Sofia Sans.
Do group tiles with a 3px seam of ground inside one rounded container.
Do derive per-show colour from the poster and clamp it so white lettering stays legible.
Do keep controls at 44px or larger on phone and keep the tab bar at the bottom there.
donts: Don't build a streaming-clone poster grid on black with a red accent.
Don't add bevels, grain, sheen, gloss or ambient card shadows; the only shadow is the toast's.
Don't use yellow for emphasis, links or ratings.
Don't print a title on an empty or partly watched case.
Don't put small tracked uppercase tags above headings; small labels only name the value beneath them.
Don't add a second authored transition; the box set sliding into its page is the one moment.
